translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
woh rehman hi hai
jiss ney Quran ki taleem di .
ussi ney insan ko peda kiya ,
ussi ney uss baat ko wazeh kerna sikhaya .
sooraj aur chaand aik hisab mein jakray huye hain ,
aur bailen aur darkht sabb uss kay aagay sajda kertay hain ,
aur aasman ko ussi ney buland kiya hai , aur ussi ney tarazoo qaeem ki hai ,
kay tum tolney mein zulm naa kero .
aur insaf kay sath wazan ko theek rakho , aur tol mein kami naa kero .
aur zameen ko ussi ney sari makhlooqaat kay liye banaya hai ,
ussi mein meway aur khujoor kay gabhon walay darkht bhi hain ,
aur bhoosay wala ghalla aur khushboodaar phool bhi .
